title: Valuation basis policy
description: Which monetary basis values loss lines by default, how quantity-based and time-based valuations combine, and the reporting currencies and FX rule. Spec VAL01 (effective-dated margin or standard cost with currency; default commercial view = contribution margin; standard cost separately named; financial policy approval recorded before production use), VAL02 (duration cost and quantity cost are alternative bases unless categories are independent cost components), VAL03 (snapshot currency and FX version; never aggregate currencies without an approved conversion snapshot). Decision D08. Consumed by sub-phase 2.6 (`valuation_policies` is `accounting_policies` kind `valuation_basis`); approval is the `POST /valuation-policies/{id}/approve` command and lives on the row, not in this document.

defaultBasis.description: Basis of the default commercial view (VAL01). The other basis stays available as a separately named view; neither is a realized saving. From version 3 (SME V8, 14 Oct 2026) `economic_impact` - lost contribution on unrecovered sales plus distinct incremental costs - is allowed when `demandRule` is present.

timeBasisRule.description: `exclusive`: a loss is valued on one basis per view; lost margin is never added to a cost-per-hour rate that already includes it (VAL02). `independent_components`: summation allowed only for impact categories explicitly marked as independent cost components.

currency.description: Version 1 only: the single tenant currency (VAL03). `XXX` (ISO 4217 'no currency') means undecided: valuation stays `unvalued` with reason `policy_unapproved`. From version 2 use `reportingCurrencies`; exactly one of the two is present.

reportingCurrencies.description: From version 2 (D08 answer 2026-10-09: IRR and USD): every valued loss is reported in each of these currencies, converted through approved, dated `fx_rates` (VAL03); when no approved rate covers the valuation date the amount in that currency is null with reason `fx_rate_missing`, never estimated.

independentImpactCodeIds.description: Impact codes whose cost per hour is an independent cost component (VAL02 `independent_components`): only for these are margin and time cost summed, in the separately named `independent_components` view.

fxPolicy.description: `none`: no conversion; an amount in another currency is null with reason `fx_rate_missing`. `snapshot`: convert with the approved `fx_rates` version in force on the valuation date and record its id (VAL03).

fxRateType.description: Version 3 (SME V5): which named FX rate table converts the values - the finance/treasury evidenced conversion basis (`economic`), the group accounting/translation policy (`group_reporting`) or a budget/constant-currency table (`budget`). Never a market label; the rate's `source` says where it comes from. Absent: `economic`.

fxDateRule.description: Version 3 (SME V6): the approved rate at each loss's date, summed into the month (default), or the time-weighted average of the approved rates over the period's local month.

fxAverageMaxDeviation.description: Version 3, `period_average` only: the average is refused (amount null, reason `fx_average_not_representative`) when a rate of the month deviates from it by more than this ratio. null = no check.

demandRule.description: Version 3 (SME V3): presence enables the `economic_impact` view. `demand_constrained_only`: lost output is lost contribution only where an approved demand status of the product says demand was constrained (sold out); otherwise the lost-sales value is 0 with the tonnes kept. A missing status leaves the line unvalued (`demand_status_missing`).

qualityDispositions.description: Version 3 (SME V2 / E3): impact code id -> what happened to the quality-loss tonnes. scrap = lost contribution (only if the sale is not recovered) + variable cost - salvage + disposal; downgrade = net price difference + disposal/handling; rework = incremental rework cost.

defaultQualityDisposition.description: Version 3: disposition of quality lines whose impact code is not mapped; null = such lines stay unvalued (`disposition_missing`).

manualLineHours.description: Version 3 (SME V4): manual downtime lines get a cost-per-hour value only for the hours of their evidenced (closed) events inside the slice, minus hours already charged by kept automatic lines or earlier manual lines.
